zotero.abstractNote: TabPFN 2.5 extends in-context learning to real business-scale data, delivering state-of-the-art accuracy on datasets up to 50 000 rows and 2 000 features. It introduces distillation for production, compressing the transformer into a compact MLP or tree ensemble, and broader scale capabilities for domains like risk, marketing-mix, and clinical analytics.
